title.narrative: Ensuring intersectorality in implementing RAM and EIT Tools in MS in Eastern Africa

description.narrative: IP 5 with drive intersectoral collaboration to enhance AI potential for positive social transformations while addressing associated risks in Eastern Africa, through infusing ethics in multistakeholder consultations and digital governance setting. This IP will leverage on work started in the region in the 41C/5 to support Member States in harnessing the benefits of AI, in line with Principles, Values and Policy Areas articulated in the UNESCO's Recommendation on the Ethics of AI, including the RAM and EIA Tools, to strengthen MS' governance capacities to achieve fair, inclusive, gender-responsive, human centered and diverse digital transformations, capitalizing on enabling frameworks as the Global Forum on Ethics of AI, the Easter Africa Regional Forum on AI and other initiatives to bring international standards on AI development and application in the region, with a deliberate effort to meaningfully engaging the youth and supporting Gender Equality and human rights as a whole in the use of AI-powered digital technologies.
